question: Who among the following has been adjudged in January 2022 as the most popular Chief Minister by India Today?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naveen Patnaik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Naveen Patnaik, the Chief Minister of Odisha, was adjudged the most popular Chief Minister by India Today in January 2022.
 
• He has been serving as the Chief Minister of Odisha since 2000, making him one of the longest-serving Chief Ministers in India.
 
• Patnaik is known for his clean and efficient governance, which has gained him widespread popularity.
 
• Under his leadership, Odisha has seen significant improvements in infrastructure, healthcare, and disaster management.
 
• His government has also been praised for its effective handling of the COVID-19 pandemic in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odisha's Governance:**

 
 
• Odisha has been recognized for its exemplary disaster management strategies, especially during cyclones.
 
• The state has implemented several welfare schemes aimed at improving the livelihoods of its citizens, including financial assistance for farmers and women.
 
• Odisha has seen substantial investments in education and healthcare under Patnaik's administration.
 
 
 
• **Naveen Patnaik's Political Career:**
 
 
• Patnaik founded the Biju Janata Dal (BJD) in 1997 after the death of his father, Biju Patnaik, a former Chief Minister of Odisha.
 
• He has won multiple state elections with significant margins, showcasing his strong political influence and popularity.
 
 
 
• **Public Welfare Initiatives:**
 
 
• Patnaik's government launched the KALIA scheme to provide financial aid to farmers and reduce poverty in rural areas.
 
• The Mission Shakti program empowers women by promoting self-help groups and providing financial support.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure Development:**
 
 
• Major infrastructure projects, including roads, bridges, and urban development, have been undertaken to boost the state's economy.
 
• Odisha has also focused on enhancing its industrial sector, attracting several large-scale investments.
